entities.name: Requested IMSI offset
entities.description: An information element that may be included by a MUSIM UE to indicate an IMSI offset value to the network for deriving the paging occasion.

entities.name: MUSIM UE
entities.description: A UE with multiple USIM capability that may include the Requested IMSI offset IE.

entities.name: IMSI offset value
entities.description: A value used for deriving the paging occasion as specified in 3GPP TS 36.304.

entities.name: Paging occasion derivation
entities.description: The process of deriving paging occasions using the IMSI offset value as specified in 3GPP TS 36.304.

relations.description: A MUSIM UE may include the Requested IMSI offset IE when needed.
The Requested IMSI offset IE carries the IMSI offset value.
The IMSI offset value is used for deriving the paging occasion.
